8: def filter_api_calls(

11:     logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
12:     tau_filter: float,
13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
15: 
16:     # Validate inputs
17:     for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
18:         if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
19:             raise ValueError("Input must be numpy arrays")
20:         if arr.ndim != 2:
21:             raise ValueError("Input must be 2D matrices")
22:         if arr.size == 0:
23:             raise ValueError("Empty arrays not allowed")
24:         if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
25:             raise ValueError("All values must be finite")
26:         if np.any(arr > 0):
27:             raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be nonpositive")
28:     if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
29:         raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
30:     if type(tau_filter) is bool or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
31:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric value, not boolean")
32:     if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
33:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
34: 
35:     n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
36:     t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
37:     raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
38:     sum_weights = np.sum(raw_weights)
39:     if sum_weights == 0:
40:         norm_weights = raw_weights

44:     loss_with = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
45:     loss_call = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
46:     loss_no = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
